acceptance_criteria.criterion: /issue-agent/authorize returns success/accepted well below the railway request ceiling and before provider completion
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Async dispatch: the handler returns 200 accepted immediately after the durable ledger record while the provider still runs; test_shutdown_drains_an_accepted_execution_worker proves the POST returns while the provider is still blocked, i.e. before provider completion.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: provider execution >300s cannot cause the github trigger to fail with http 499
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The accepted response is decoupled from provider runtime: the trigger request completes before the provider, so a long-running provider can no longer pin the request open up to a client close.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: retrying a failed attempt does not mutate the issue and does not change the authorization identity
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The ledger keeps the authorization identity immutable; a retry of a claimed/failed identity raises IssueAgentReplayError and never reclaims or re-executes (test_a_live_foreign_lease_is_never_failed_or_reclaimed, test_an_expired_incomplete_owner_is_recovered_fail_closed).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: source handling authority is exact, fail-closed, and retry-stable for an immutable event
acceptance_criteria.evidence: This criterion remains tracked by the broader Issue #461 stabilization matrix and is intentionally outside this focused async-issuer candidate.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: the exact pinned opencode/provider configuration is compatibility-checked before live use
acceptance_criteria.evidence: This criterion remains tracked by the broader Issue #461 stabilization matrix and is intentionally outside this focused async-issuer candidate.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: runtime capability requirements are checked before provider execution
acceptance_criteria.evidence: This criterion remains tracked by the broader Issue #461 stabilization matrix and is intentionally outside this focused async-issuer candidate.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: opencode can modify only the isolated attempt workspace; external-directory edits are explicitly denied. — pr #465 / ca2adf5ebeb5e11b198e50de6d0a62af5b23207c
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Base state from PR #465 / ca2adf5 carries the isolated workspace boundary; this candidate adds no workspace or external-directory authority.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: a provider claiming success without candidate repository changes fails closed
acceptance_criteria.evidence: This criterion remains tracked by the broader Issue #461 stabilization matrix and is intentionally outside this focused async-issuer candidate.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: publication remains trusted-parent-owned and exact-head validation remains authoritative
acceptance_criteria.evidence: This candidate adds no publication authority and no admission authority; publication and exact-head validation remain unchanged and trusted-parent-owned.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: accepted authorization executes at most once and ends in a durable completed or failed state
acceptance_criteria.evidence: At-most-once is enforced by the ledger: claim is refused for a replayed identity (IssueAgentReplayError) and lease expiry never permits reclaim; every accepted execution ends durably COMPLETED or FAILED, shutdown drains accepted workers to a terminal outcome, and a drain timeout never fabricates FAILED for a still-running provider.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: stale/closed pr history cannot generate a false current governance failure
acceptance_criteria.evidence: This criterion remains tracked by the broader Issue #461 stabilization matrix and is intentionally outside this focused async-issuer candidate.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: no autonomous ready, merge, or railway deploy is introduced
acceptance_criteria.evidence: This candidate introduces no Ready, merge, deploy, shell, network, or publication authority: it changes only issuer execution ownership/lease semantics and shutdown handling.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: only after this matrix is green do we run the live #441 acceptance test
acceptance_criteria.evidence: This is a process criterion for the live acceptance gate and is intentionally not assessed by this focused review.
